Best Cardiac Physician in Meerut: Dr. Gurjeet Singh Gill Answers Your Heart Health Questions

Namaste, main Dr. Gurjeet Singh Gill hoon, ek cardiac physician, aur main aapke dil ki baat karta hoon. Aaj ke daur mein, heart disease ek badi samasya ban gayi hai, especially India mein. Meerut aur Delhi NCR mein bhi hum bahut se heart patients dekhte hain. Lekin ghabrane ki baat nahi hai – sahi jankari, sahi lifestyle, aur sahi doctor ke saath, aap apne dil ko healthy rakh sakte hain. Is blog mein, main aapke kuch common sawalon ke jawab de raha hoon, jo patients mujhse aksar poochte hain. Toh chaliye, shuru karte hain.

❓ Patient Question: "Dr. Gill, mere seene mein dard hota hai. Kya ye heart attack hai? Mujhe kya karna chahiye?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Dekhiye, seene mein dard hone ke bahut se karan ho sakte hain. Har seene ka dard heart attack nahi hota, lekin ise ignore karna bilkul theek nahi hai. Agar aapko seene mein bhaaripan, dabav, ya jalan mehsoos ho rahi hai, jo left arm, jaw, ya peeth tak jaa rahi hai, aur saath mein paseena aa raha hai, saans phool rahi hai, toh ye heart attack ke lakshan ho sakte hain. Aise mein turant 108 ambulance bulayein ya nazdeeki hospital jaayein. Agar dard halka hai aur kabhi-kabhi hota hai, toh bhi aapko cardiac physician se milna chahiye. Hum aapka ECG, Echo, aur zaroorat padne par TMT ya Angiography karte hain. Meerut mein Gill Heart Clinic par hum aise cases rozana dekhte hain. Sahi samay par ilaaj se bade nuksan se bacha ja sakta hai. Isliye, kisi bhi tarah ke seene ke dard ko halke mein na lein.

❓ Patient Question: "Kya heart attack ke baad normal life ji sakti hai? Mera ek dost heart attack ke baad depression mein chala gaya."

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Bilkul ji sakte hain! Heart attack ke baad zindagi rukti nahi, balki ek nayi shuruaat hoti hai. Sahi treatment, lifestyle changes, aur regular follow-up se aap lambi, healthy life jee sakte hain. Depression ek common problem hai heart attack ke baad, kyunki patient dar jata hai. Lekin ise accept karna aur ilaaj karana zaroori hai. Hum patients ko cardiac rehabilitation program mein bhejte hain, jisme exercise, diet, aur counseling shamil hai. Dawaon ka sahi se paalan karein, smoking chhodein, alcohol kam karein, aur stress manage karein. Dr. Eugene Braunwald, jo cardiology ke father maane jaate hain, unke research ke mutabik, heart attack ke baad secondary prevention se mortality rate 30% tak kam ho sakti hai. Toh haan, normal life possible hai, bas discipline chahiye.

❓ Patient Question: "Doctor, mere papa ko high BP hai. Kya unhe heart attack ka khatra hai? Kaise bachayein?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: High BP (hypertension) heart attack ka ek bada risk factor hai. Lekin agar aap BP ko control mein rakhein, toh khatra kaafi kam ho jata hai. American Heart Association (AHA) ke guidelines ke mutabik, BP 130/80 mmHg se kam hona chahiye. Aapke papa ko regular BP check karana chahiye, namak kam khana chahiye (din mein 5 gram se kam), potassium-rich foods jaise kela, nariyal paani, palak khana chahiye. Dawaon ka sahi se paalan karein. PM Jan Aushadhi generic medicines se ilaaj sasta aur asardar ho sakta hai. Unhe walk, yoga, aur stress management ki salah dein. Agar BP zyada hai, toh doctor se mil kar dawa adjust karwayein. Unhe saal mein ek baar heart check-up zaroor karana chahiye. Gill Heart Clinic mein hum aise patients ko manage karte hain aur unki lifestyle mein badlav laakar heart attack ka risk kam karte hain.

❓ Patient Question: "Kya Indian diet heart ke liye achhi hai? Mujhe kya khana chahiye aur kya nahi?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Indian diet heart-friendly ho sakti hai, agar hum sahi choices karein. Aapko ghee, butter, coconut oil, aur processed foods se bachna chahiye. Instead, olive oil, mustard oil, aur rice bran oil use karein. Zyada sabziyan, phal, whole grains jaise dalia, brown rice, oats, aur legumes khayein. Namak aur cheeni kam karein. Fried foods, samosa, pakoda, aur mithaiyan kam khayein. Non-veg mein machhli (omega-3 fatty acids) achhi hai, lekin red meat se bachein. Dahi, chaach, aur low-fat dairy theek hai. Dr. Valentin Fuster, renowned cardiologist, kehte hain ki Mediterranean diet heart ke liye best hai, lekin hum Indian diet ko modify karke bhi wahi fayde le sakte hain. Jaise, roti ke saath sabzi, dal, salad, aur dahi. Chawal kam, roti zyada. Aur haan, paani khoob piyein. Gill Heart Clinic mein hum dietitian ke saath mil kar aapke liye personalized diet chart banate hain.

❓ Patient Question: "Exercise se heart attack ka risk kam hota hai? Kitna exercise karein?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Ji haan, regular exercise heart attack ka risk kaafi kam karta hai. American Heart Association recommends ki hafte mein kam se kam 150 minutes moderate-intensity aerobic exercise karein, jaise brisk walking, cycling, swimming, ya dancing. Iske alawa, hafte mein 2 din strength training bhi karein. Agar aap pehle se heart patient hain, toh doctor se pooch kar exercise shuru karein. Hum aksar 30-40 minute ki walk se shuru karne ki salah dete hain. Dhyan rakhein, exercise ke dauran seene mein dard, saans phoolna, ya chakkar aana band kar dein aur doctor se milein. Exercise se BP control hota hai, weight kam hota hai, cholesterol improve hota hai, aur stress kam hota hai. SPRINT Trial 2015 ke mutabik, intensive BP control se heart attack aur stroke ka risk kam hota hai. Toh aaj se hi exercise shuru karein, lekin apne doctor ki salah se.

❓ Patient Question: "Kya cholesterol ki dawa zindagi bhar leni padegi? Iske side effects kya hain?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Cholesterol ki dawa, jaise statins, heart attack aur stroke ka risk kam karti hai. Agar aapko heart disease hai, diabetes hai, ya cholesterol bahut zyada hai, toh ye dawa lambi avadhi tak ya zindagi bhar leni pad sakti hai. Iske side effects kam hote hain, lekin kuch logon ko muscle pain, liver enzyme badhna, ya sugar level badhna ho sakta hai. Isliye regular monitoring zaroori hai. Dr. Deepak L. Bhatt, ek renowned cardiologist, kehte hain ki statins ke benefits side effects se kaafi zyada hain. Agar side effects hote hain, toh doctor dawa badal sakte hain ya dose adjust kar sakte hain. PM Jan Aushadhi se generic statins sasti milti hain. Dawa kabhi bhi apne aap band na karein. Gill Heart Clinic mein hum patients ko sahi dawa aur dose dete hain aur regular follow-up karte hain.

🩺 Dr. Gill's Clinical Experience

Gill Heart Clinic, Mohiuddinpur, Meerut mein, hum rozana 50-60 patients dekhte hain. Inme se kuch cases yaadgar hain. Ek 45 saal ke businessman the, unhe chest pain tha, lekin wo ignore kar rahe the. Jab wo clinic aaye, toh unka ECG abnormal tha. Humne turant angiography karayi, jisme 90% blockage nikla. Unka angioplasty hua aur ab wo bilkul theek hain. Ek aur case, 60 saal ki mahila, jinko high BP aur diabetes thi. Unhe heart attack aa gaya. Humne unhe thrombolysis diya aur phir cardiac rehab mein bheja. Aaj wo apne ghar ka kaam kar rahi hain. In cases se humne seekha ki samay par ilaaj aur lifestyle changes se jaan bachayi ja sakti hai. Hum patients ko sirf dawa nahi dete, balki unhe heart-healthy lifestyle apnane mein madad karte hain.

Indian-Specific Diet and Lifestyle Advice

Indian diet aur lifestyle heart ke liye bahut maayne rakhte hain. Yahan kuch tips hain:

  • Namak kam karein: Din mein 5 gram se kam namak. Achar, papad, namkeen se bachein.
  • Fried foods avoid karein: Samosa, pakoda, puri, bhujia ki jagah roasted chana, makhana khayein.
  • Whole grains: Roti, dalia, brown rice, oats khayein. White rice aur maida kam karein.
  • Healthy fats: Ghee ki jagah mustard oil, olive oil, ya rice bran oil. Nuts aur seeds khayein.
  • Fruits and vegetables: Rozana 5 servings. Seasonal fruits jaise seb, kela, santra, anar.
  • Dairy: Low-fat doodh, dahi, chaach. Cheese aur butter kam.
  • Protein: Dal, rajma, chana, machhli, chicken (without skin). Red meat avoid karein.
  • Exercise: Rozana 30-40 minute walk, yoga, ya cycling.
  • Stress management: Meditation, deep breathing, aur acchi neend.
  • Smoking and alcohol: Bilkul chhodein.

PM Jan Aushadhi generic medicines se aap sasti dawa le sakte hain. Meerut mein bhi Jan Aushadhi store hain. Apne doctor se generic dawa ke baare mein poochein.

FAQ

❓ Kya heart attack ke baad sex kar sakte hain?

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Ji haan, heart attack ke baad sex safe hai, agar aap stable hain aur doctor ne permission di hai. Usually 4-6 weeks baad. Lekin agar sex ke dauran chest pain ya saans phoolti hai, toh doctor se milein.

❓ Kya heart disease hereditary hai?

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Family history heart disease ka risk badhata hai. Agar aapke parents ya siblings ko heart disease hai, toh aapko regular check-up karana chahiye aur lifestyle improve karni chahiye.

❓ Kya ECG se heart attack ka pata chalta hai?

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: ECG heart attack ka pata lagane mein madad karta hai, lekin hamesha nahi. Kuch cases mein Echo, TMT, ya angiography ki zaroorat padti hai.

❓ Kya main bina dawa ke cholesterol control kar sakta hoon?

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Halke cholesterol ko diet aur exercise se control kiya ja sakta hai. Lekin agar zyada hai ya aapko heart disease hai, toh dawa zaroori hai. Doctor se poochein.
